title: FSDO: Incident Status Update — UAS-11

transcript.speaker: FSDO
transcript.text: Incident Commander, this is the FAA FSDO (FSDO contact: (585) 555-0188). UAS-11 has been landed manually on the meadow. The GCS is quarantined. The fleet of that type is grounded per ISP Section 9.1. The incident is under investigation. The FSDO has been updated on the status and the hold on data transfer. Please confirm that all required logs and telemetry have been submitted and that no further flights will occur until the investigation is closed.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the final operational status to regulators and triggers the incident closure process. Watch for the ASO to validate the FSDO’s confirmation and initiate the handover to the IC for formal closure.
